_comment: Dashboard for the GuppiGPT tenant wfd05358. Written by hand in the shape of a platform dashboard export; import it through the Dashboards app (Upload). Queries were revised on 5 Sep 2026 against what the tenant holds: spans from the instrumented runtime (service guppi_gpt.DEFAULT), RUM user.events, and CloudWatch metrics under cloud.aws.bedrock_agentcore once the AWS integration imports that namespace.

tiles.name: Runs per hour
tiles.reliesOn: One server span named POST /invocations per run, service guppi_gpt.DEFAULT, exported by the instrumented container (observed in the tenant 5 Sep 2026).

tiles.name: First delta latency p50/p90
tiles.reliesOn: Duration of the POST /invocations server span, which is the whole run rather than the first delta; the first delta lives only on the agent's log line in CloudWatch (runtime-logs), which Firehose does not forward.

tiles.name: Run outcome split
tiles.reliesOn: The failure flag on the POST /invocations server span. RUN_ERROR events emitted on a 200 stream are not failures here; the outcome field on the agent's CloudWatch log line is the finer source.

tiles.name: Retrieval rate
tiles.reliesOn: The MCP client span named mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve appears once per retrieval; runs are the POST /invocations spans.

queries.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "guppi_gpt.DEFAULT" and (span.name == "POST /invocations" or span.name == "mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve")
| summarize runs = countIf(span.name == "POST /invocations"), retrievals = countIf(span.name == "mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve")
| fields retrievalRatePct = retrievals * 100.0 / runs

tiles.name: Token usage
tiles.reliesOn: The Strands model span (named chat <model id>) carries the GenAI semantic convention usage attributes; if the attribute names differ in this Strands version, inspect one chat span in Distributed Tracing and adjust.

tiles.name: Feedback up/down ratio
tiles.reliesOn: The business event guppigpt.reply-feedback, ingested through the EventBridge API destination the stack creates (docs/proposals/feedback.md). The RUM custom action this tile used to query was never stored by the tenant; the vote now arrives on the bizevents table with vote, run.id, and trace.id as top-level fields.

tiles.name: WAF counts
tiles.reliesOn: CloudWatch metric WafBlocks in AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore, which exists in the account since the rules moved to BLOCK on 4 Sep 2026; the Dynatrace key follows its cloud.aws.<namespace>.<metric> convention and the AWS integration must import the Bedrock-AgentCore namespace (a custom namespace in the integration's metric selection).

tiles.name: 403 loopback rejections
tiles.reliesOn: CloudWatch metric UserErrors on the edge gateway; the loopback URL rejection happens at the gateway's load balancer and is not separately counted, so this tile shows all 4xx.
